column1: # path prefix -> area.  LONGEST PREFIX WINS, so specific rows may precede general ones in any order.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: `BUGS.md` carries an `area:` field, but its values were assigned by a
# first-match keyword heuristic over the slug plus the first 1400 characters of the body
# (`scripts/bugs-index-migrate`, AREA_HINTS). `front` is first in that list and its keys include
# `parse`, `_err` and `front`, so it wins for almost any text — 256 of 621 entries. The field is
# therefore validated against an enum but not derived from anything checkable.
# A code path IS checkable: a defect in `.../codegen/JsGen.scala` is codegen, whatever words its
# description happens to contain. This file is that mapping, and `scripts/area-of` reads it.
# The areas are exactly the enum in specs/bugs-index.md — deliberately not extended, so the two
# cannot disagree about what an area IS even while they disagree about which one a bug belongs to.
# Added because the gate's TOTALITY check caught them missing — on its own author, which is the
# point of walking the tree instead of listing directories by hand.
